Alger, 24 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 24, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Fourteen Algerian start-ups received awards at the closing ceremony of the eighth edition of the Algeria Startup Challenge 2026, on Monday in Algiers. They emerged from 294 projects that submitted responses to economic, environmental, and industrial challenges.
À Alger, la clôture de la huitième éditi: In Algiers, the closing of the eighth edition of the competition honored fourteen start-ups. They came from 294 start-ups and projects that proposed technological solutions for economic, environmental, and industrial challenges. The Leancubator incubator organized the event under the patronage of three ministries, including Knowledge Economy, Start-ups and Micro-enterprises, Vocational Training and Education, and Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries.
Les projets primés étaient répartis sur: The award-winning projects were divided across four challenges. They were organized with companies and economic operators. The green technologies track selected four projects. First place went to UNO INDUSTRY, which designs patented machines to collect used tires and promote their recycling.
Le volet distribution et industrie a dis: The distribution and industry track honored four projects. WIN INSIGHT AI took first place in the industry section. This solution uses artificial intelligence to monitor equipment, analyze energy consumption, and detect anomalies without interrupting production. In the distribution section, Cursus, developed by Nrouhou, optimizes truck and bus routes, tracks vehicles, and seeks to reduce durations, fuel, and costs.
Le challenge de réduction des risques a: The risk reduction challenge rewarded three start-up projects. Aquabloom secured first place. It extracts a natural coagulant from agri-food residues to treat wastewater and rainwater, eliminate impurities, and enable reuse for irrigation or cleaning.
Le challenge innovation et assurance a d: The innovation and insurance challenge honored three start-ups. Cyris received first place. It offers digital tools to evaluate and quantify cybersecurity-related risks, transforming security data into clear indicators for businesses and insurers.
En marge de la cérémonie, six convention: On the sidelines of the ceremony, six agreements were signed. They connect partner companies of the challenges with certain winning start-ups. The objective is to support the projects, back the implementation of their solutions, and strengthen cooperation in green technologies, distribution, smart industry, and insurance.
